EmailTemplate.description: Reusable notification to the country Finance queue for Special Instruction items worked on the Finance Dashboard - covers Billing Mode Change (B2), Different Invoice Currency (B3), and Credit Limit (B4). Type is shown dynamically. Button links to the DE Finance dashboard where Finance acknowledges/approves/rejects. Notification only. Digital Edge orange theme.
EmailTemplate.name: DE Finance Review Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: Finance Review Required: {!Special_Instruction__c.Type__c} - {!Special_Instruction__c.Name} - {!Special_Instruction__c.DE_Subsidiary_Name__c}
